subject: Film & Cinema
title: Blaxploitation and Minority Voices
description: Learn Blaxploitation and Minority Voices in one minute.

hook.text: In the early 1970s, Black audiences finally saw heroes who looked like them on screen.

buildup.text: Films like Shaft and Super Fly featured Black leads in stories set in their communities.

discovery.text: These films were hugely profitable and saved several struggling studios from bankruptcy.

twist.text: Critics debated whether the genre empowered or stereotyped Black communities.

climax.text: Blaxploitation paved the way for Spike Lee, John Singleton, and modern Black cinema.

quiz.question: What was a lasting impact of blaxploitation films?
options: They paved the way for future Black filmmakers
They were only shown in Europe
